mentions.name: Rusty Checkers
mentions.description: A checkers game built in Rust using Rama and Yew, hosted at rusty-checkers.fly.dev. Websockets are being added so people can actually play the game live.
mentions.audience: People who want to play checkers online
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on a checkers game:

https://rusty-checkers.fly.dev

It's built in Rust using Rama and Yew. Trying now to get websockets going so people can actually play.
